title: Peptide Lip Boost Plumping Lip Mask
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Peptide✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Gluten Free✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Hyaluronic Acid
What it is: A thick, balmy lip mask that’s clinically shown to visibly plump lips quickly and over time.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Multipeptide: A blend of four peptides that support visibly fuller lips.
- Konjac Hyaluronic Complex: Improves the look of lip volume over time.
- Vanillyl Butyl Ether (VBE): Provides a tingly-yet-comfy sensation to visibly plump lips.

What Else You Need to Know: Peptide Lip Boost is a plumping lip mask that visibly enhances volume quickly and over time. rhode’s thick, balmy formula provides a tingly-yet-comfy sensation for a fast plumping effect. Wear it every day to improve the look of lip fullness while softening the appearanc
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-For a fast lip boost, apply day or night.
-Use in your everyday routine for even more volumizing benefits over time.
-rhode trick: Apply a thick layer during glam, then wipe off any excess and follow with your go-to lip combo.
Ingredients+
-Multipeptide: A blend of four peptides that support visibly fuller lips.
-Konjac Hyaluronic Complex: Improves the look of lip volume over time.
-Vanillyl Butyl Ether (VBE): Provides a tingly-yet-comfy sensation to visibly plump lips.

Polybutene, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Bis-Diglyceryl Polyacyladipate-2, Polyethylene, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil*, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Fragrance (Parfum), Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer, Dipalmitoyl Hydroxyproline, Tocopherol, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-38, Hexapeptide-3, Acetyl Hexapeptide-37, Acetyl Hexapeptide-38, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Lactic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Stevioside, Vanillyl Butyl Ether, Ceramide NP, Glucomannan, Octyldodecanol, Cetearyl Alcohol, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, PEG-20 Glyceryl Triisostearate, Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer, Sorbitan Oleate, Synthetic Beeswax, Water/Aqua/Eau, Trihydroxystearin, Ethylhexylglycerin, Menthol, Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Oil, Mentha Viridis (Spearmint) Leaf Oil, Carvone, Limonene, Beta-Caryophyllene, Pinene, Red 30 Lake (CI 73360), Red 7 Lake (CI 15850).
